reviews.text: Sarah and the team always look after our mice. There's not many exotic vets that we trust with our pets but Sarah is one of them.

I’ve been here multiple times with my rabbits, and Sarah is genuinely one of the best vets I’ve ever seen. She is incredibly thorough, takes the time to explain everything in detail, and always shows such care, compassion and understanding.

I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Sarah to anyone with rabbits. You can really tell that she genuinely cares about the animals she treats, and I’ve always felt they are in the best hands with her.

Excellent vets who do their jobs well.However,the consultation charge is OUTRAGEOUS at £66 (up from £46) on before any meds are with issued.
Vets are getting greedy and extortionate and they are causing sick animals to suffer and die bevause people can’t afford to pay these large amounts.
GREEDY and UNETHICAL!
Professional and passionate about exotic creatures, specifically in our case tortoises.

The reception was incredible and we were made to feel at ease immediately. The vet was very knowledgable and thorough with my bunny and this was the best vet experience i have ever had. I will never take my pets anywhere else but holly house. Thank you for the incredible experience.

Following a dog attack on my tortoise (tortellini) the team have been absolutely amazing and super helpful with supporting us the last few weeks, he’s thriving and healing better than we ever imagined!

With regular wound bandage changes we’ve been in and out whilst living an hour away and unfortunately today I had to bring my toddler in (who wasn’t happy) however the amazing nurse printed some pictures for him to colour and when that didn’t work got him involved helping her with little jobs! They really do care and aim to be so supportive to all their clients and a massive shout out to Emma today for helping with a bored and excitable 2 year old, it made his day.

Just taken my guinea pig here and all the staff were lovely! The vet was extremely knowledgeable about guinea pigs especially compared to other vets (we went to vets for pets first). I would recommend anyone with Guinea pigs or exotic pets to come here. We felt so welcomed and we left reassured.
Amazing staff really friendly and understanding. Took my tortoise in as an emergency and looked at him straight away. Great advice and knowledge, can’t thank you enough 5⭐️

Stella the chicken and me were looked after extremely well by all the staff at Holly House exotics. The vet Tom explained all the options for Stella's treatment very clearly and a lot of care was taken during this appointment. I wish there were more vets who had this level of expertise on chickens. I wouldn't go anywhere else.

Hello, thank you for the 5 star review!

Can’t thank the amazing Tom enough! We took our rat in worried sick and Tom was absolutely brilliant, super thorough and kind, he mentioned every medication I’d researched prior to the appointment! Our little rat is so much better all thanks to the care and knowledge from Tom

I pushed for an escalation on the treatment of the family rabbit, after 6-7 months of apparently just treating 'symptoms'; not underlying issues. Was offered a referral to Holly House Exotics, which I would have taken sooner, if suggested. Super impressed after treatment at Holly House Exotics under Hannah Clark; with massive improvements in just 2 weeks. It's clearly very important to get treatment with a specialist; as your local general vet may not tell you that they're not quite sure or confident in what they are doing.
Extremely fast service was seen within minutes of walking through the door great attentive and friendly staff and really reasonably priced

My visit to Holly House Exotics was a lovely, calm experience. The staff were very friendly and helpful, and the vet explained  various scenarios re my pet budgie and the problem we had. Even my budgie seemed happy, allowing a thorough examination and he didn't seem stressed by it. I was concerned about him before we went but I left feeling reassured. Very helpful and caring staff from reception to the vet. Welcoming atmosphere. Treat our pet with great care and we're very thorough

I had to book an emergency appointment for my bearded dragon and the whole team from the reception staff to the vet were lovely and super helpful, they saw me same day and my beardie got lot's of care and the vet talked me through what she was looking for and what she was doing to check for certain things which was hugely appreciated, so thank you Holly house!

We love it here! Despite my pet’s age and breed meaning that if he has any problems the outcome is unlikely to be great, we always feel in safe hands at Holly House. Amazing to have a clinic specifically for exotics now too - we wouldn’t go anywhere else.

The level of help and knowledge the vet had was amazing.  They put our minds at ease and there follow up has also been exceptional. I highly recomend them they are knowledgeable helpfull and put your pet first

I have been to a couple of exotic vets and this is by far the best one. One of my birds is disabled and I have complete confidence in the vets I see here especially Emma and Tom.

They give me excellent advice and take the time to answer all of my questions in check-ups. A couple of years ago I have to have a budgies put to sleep and a different vet gave me a ink foot print  and I am so glad I have it.

Charlotte on reception has also always been lovely, prompt and very helpful, in-person and also by email.

had a very disappointing and distressing phone call with a member of staff who at answered the phone on 31st December 2025 at 14:31 at Holly House Exotics.
I had seen a kind and professional avian vet on Monday 29th December regarding my poorly budgie, Lucy. The vet advised that if Lucy did not improve, she would need to be put to sleep very soon due to her quality of life.
When I explained this situation to the receptionist who answered the phone today, I was told that the practice would be closed on Friday. I was shocked by this response, especially given the urgency and seriousness of the situation.
Concerned, I then contacted Battle Flatts Veterinary Practice in Stamford Bridge, where I had previously been registered for many years when I lived in York. After explaining everything, their receptionist told me she had just spoken to Holly House Exotics and confirmed that they are, in fact, open on Friday.
Because of this misinformation, I am now travelling from Leeds to Stamford Bridge to have my budgie put to sleep, which has been extremely upsetting and stressful at an already emotional time.
Unfortunately, this interaction felt very unprofessional. I have also seen previous reviews mentioning similar issues about being incorrectly told the practice was closed, so this does not appear to be an isolated incident.
Overall, my budgie was very poorly, and this situation was handled badly by a member of staff, adding unnecessary distress during a heartbreaking time.
